clauses.reason: The selection explanation moves from changed to ready --explain.

updates.rationale: Journal-only reuse removes duplicate testing without guessing source impacts or weakening source approval, failure accounting and input identity.
updates.statement: Structured repository selection is optional. ready --explain explains the selection without checks. Without a provider, readiness selects the complete member-safe gate; only a proved journal-only suffix may reuse successful matching test evidence after current admission. Other paths require a provider for narrowing or inheritance. Final always executes its complete declared gate.

clauses.reason: Admission runs only what the repository declares for it; final stays the complete check.

updates.rationale: Only final is heavy; repeating member tests at every admission duplicated the complete final run.
updates.statement: Diagnostics, readiness and CI share supervised execution and allocation. Admission and continuation prepare the exact merged increment since the last passing batch tip and execute only the declared batch gate, which may run no integration checks; cross-member failures then surface at final. Without a provider readiness selects the full member-safe gate. Final remains complete.

clauses.reason: The development loop belongs to the protocol, in one operation.

updates.rationale: One loop removes a step agents skipped, and readiness evidence keeps one owner.
scope: Local commands, validation and agent instructions
updates.statement: ready is the only member lifecycle operation that runs checks and is the development loop: commit, ready, fix, commit, ready. ready --explain shows its selection without checks. The lifecycle has seven operations; changed is not one of them.

clauses.reason: A defect that exists only in the combination needs a repair place where it can be reproduced.

updates.rationale: Batch-owned fixes keep combination repairs reviewable without letting unattributed work reach delivery.
updates.statement: A defect that appears only when members combine may be fixed by commits made directly in the batch under the batch's own approved change record, approval before implementation and journaled, and is validated by the next final. A member-owned defect is fixed in its member and re-admitted. Final refuses a first-parent non-merge batch commit that changes paths outside change records and decisions unless an approved batch-owned change precedes it, and its review attributes each such commit to those changes. Merge-conflict resolution is unchanged. After a failed final, status names both repairs.

decisions.reason: Agents skipped any check before ready and paid a long ready for cheap failures, while changed only explained a plan. One operation that both explains and runs removes a step and keeps readiness evidence with its single owner; making ready fast is the job of a light member gate, inheritance and ordering, not of a second operation. Admission repeated member test execution for every increment although final reruns the complete gate, so the owner accepted that cross-member failures surface at final. Batch-only defects previously had no repair place other than a member, which cannot reproduce them. Reopen if cross-member failures found at final cost more than admission-time execution in observed use.

transaction.reason: Apply the owner-approved one-loop, light admission and batch-fix decision
